question: Where can I find a golf course that sit within 60 kilometers on the north side of WORKS/San José, San Jose, CA?
sql: WITH san_jose_location AS ( SELECT geometry AS sj_geometry, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS sj_centroid FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%San Jose%' AND region_name ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), golf_courses AS ( SELECT poi_name AS name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' ) SELECT gc.name FROM golf_courses AS gc, san_jose_location AS sj WHERE ST_DWithin(gc.geometry::geography, sj.sj_geometry::geography, 60000) AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(sj.sj_centroid, ST_Centroid(gc.geometry))) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(sj.sj_centroid, ST_Centroid(gc.geometry))) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 );
